stem: Which sentence from the selection conveys the idea that people were beginning to follow Big Bird’s story?

options.label: F
options.text: Startled tourists may have assumed the bird was an adult because of his large size.

options.label: G
options.text: They cared for Big Bird, as they called the young pelican, and nursed him back to health.

options.label: H
options.text: The staff members, however, were not discouraged.

options.label: J
options.text: After some more practice, Big Bird rewarded his growing fan club with a video of a successful flight.
